name: Outlook OOO Auto Cancel & Decline | AI-Enhanced

parameters.formTitle: Out of Office — Cancel & Decline Meetings (AI-Enhanced)

values.fieldLabel: Reason (will be added to the cancellation/decline email)
values.placeholder: e.g. on vacation, sick leave, business trip

options.customCss: button[type="submit"]:disabled::after{content:"Do not close this window. Outlook Events are loading.";display:block;margin-top:12px;color:#c5221f;font-weight:600;font-size:0.9rem;}

messageValues.message:
You decide what to do with a calendar event while the user is out of office. Choose exactly one action and return json with keys action, confidence (0..1) and reason.

Allowed actions:
- "cancel": the user ORGANIZES the meeting and there are attendees. Cancelling notifies everyone and removes it for all.
- "decline": the user was INVITED (not organizer) and a response is requested. Declines with a note, meeting stays for others.
- "delete": the user was invited, no response is expected/possible, but the entry should be removed from the user's own calendar only.
- "keep": leave the event untouched. Use this as the SAFE fallback whenever you are unsure, when the event looks important to keep informed on (e.g. very large meetings, all-hands, town halls where the user is one of many), or when none of the other actions clearly fit.

Prefer "keep" over guessing. Set confidence below 0.5 when uncertain; a low-confidence result will be treated as keep.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: {"action":"cancel","confidence":0.9,"reason":"Short human-readable justification for the chosen action."}
